_comment: Provenance for the byte-exact v2/v4 snapshot pair config/sdkjs-handoff.v2.snapshot.json and config/sdkjs-handoff-fixture.v4.snapshot.json. Both files are committed EXACTLY as fetched -- never reformat, re-serialize, or hand-edit them: the admission gate in scripts/lib/sdkjs-handoff.mjs verifies the handoff's bytes and sha256 against the fixture's input pin, so any local mutation (including pretty-printing) is rejected as a tampered/locally-reconstructed projection (honua-io/honua-samples#16). Refreshed automatically by scripts/build-gallery.mjs whenever the live fetch succeeds and the fetched pair passes admission.
